ack.description: Acknowledge a rotation prepare. Stores the candidate; does not activate it.

prepare_event_id.description: Lowercase canonical UUIDv4 of the security.key.prepare event.

commit.description: Commit the rotation. Stops writing old wraps; the recipient retains the old private key for 24 hours or 100 accepted events, then deletes it.

confirm.description: Confirm decryption of at least one new-epoch wrap.

prepare.description: Propose a new relationship X25519 keypair for epoch N+1, with the prior fingerprint and a 24-hour deadline.

deadline.description: Acknowledgment deadline, UTC whole seconds (24 hours after prepare).

new_agreement_key.description: New epoch X25519 public key, multibase base58btc.

prior_fingerprint.description: Base64url (no padding) fingerprint of the prior epoch public key.

description: Key-rotation payloads: security.key.prepare, security.key.ack, security.key.confirm, security.key.commit. The envelope's protected event_type selects the variant.
title: Security payloads
